note: The declared SSH access path per machine, for the fleet observation collector (ticket 01 of fleet-ssh-access). No credentials live here and none may: the destination is an ssh alias, user@host, or a bare host, and it is passed to ssh verbatim. A machine with no record here is reported as no-access-record and its readings carry that fact. A record that is malformed, duplicated, or whose serial contradicts the machine's own inventory row is reported and the machine is NOT probed. Everything still uncovered needs its access approved first: see tickets 02-04 of this set.
